description: This file defines the RouteService class which extends AbstractService and implements RouteServiceInterface. It manages application routing, interacts with URL parameters, and observes application events to notify route changes.

classes.name: RouteService
classes.description: A service class responsible for managing routing within the application, including URL manipulation and event observation.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Cleans up resources and unsubscribes from events.

methods.name: getRoute
methods.description: Returns a new RouteParser instance based on the current URL.

methods.name: isDotOrg
methods.description: Checks whether the current host is 'app.standardnotes.org'.

methods.name: removeQueryParameterFromURL
methods.description: Removes a specified query parameter from the current URL.

methods.name: addAppEventObserver
methods.description: Sets up an event observer for application events, particularly handling local data loaded events.
